## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 💄 UI / Design tweak (updates to QML styling, themes, or layouts)

## Checklist
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the [DCO](../CONTRIBUTING.md#license-and-sign-off).
- [ ] New user-visible text has Ukrainian and English strings, and nothing is specific to my machine (monitor names, paths, language).
- [ ] My code follows the shared design components, semantic tokens and owned subscriptions.
- [ ] I have run the available non-mutating format, lint and type checks; any unavailable checks are listed below.
- [ ] Tests exercise imported product behavior, including relevant device removal, unavailable-service and recovery states.
- [ ] I have recorded native/runtime versions and relevant isolated Hyprland checks; skipped checks are identified as unverified.
- [ ] (If applicable) I have attached **Screenshots or Screen Recordings** demonstrating the UI changes.
